description: Appearance options in the current profile (UX6): density, accent, more contrast, the new tab's ambience and reduced transparency. Built-in Shell only; each function takes one of the declared values, and no option can touch a protection.

functions.name: openSettings
functions.description: Open the one settings page (about:preferences, ADR 0008) at a pane, or at the pane that holds one of the old page's sections. With replace, in the calling tab.
